name: Side Indicator 1 Code
definition: To indicate either the reference for the Central Counterparty (CCP) leg or the reference for the client leg of the transaction.

CCPL.name: CCP Leg
CCPL.definition: Clearing broker identification is for the Central Counterparty (CCP) leg.

CLNT.name: Client Leg
CLNT.definition: Clearing broker identification is for the client leg.
